statusDefinitions.FULL_AUTOMATED: Specific executable assertions cover every catalog assertion; a broad suite pass, inventory check, source-text check, or SSR-only check is insufficient.
statusDefinitions.PARTIAL: One or more substantive assertions are automated, but a catalog assertion, fixture parameter, bridge path, or end-state check is still missing.
statusDefinitions.BROWSER_BLOCKED: The case requires real browser interaction or visual evidence; source and SSR tests are supporting evidence only and Chromium did not execute.
statusDefinitions.LOCAL_PERSISTENCE_PENDING: Unit/in-memory coverage exists, but the required isolated Wrangler mutation, process restart, and recovery run has not yet been executed.
statusDefinitions.OWNER_BLOCKED: The case requires the authenticated original owner state or signed-in panel, which is unavailable in this environment.
statusDefinitions.LIVE_NOT_RUN: The case requires separately authorized live provider/source calls and semantic review; no such calls were made.
statusDefinitions.DELIVERY_NOT_AUTHORIZED: Publication or owner update for the new tree is outside the current authorization.

evidenceClasses.EXECUTABLE: The named test executes production code and asserts the mapped behavior.
evidenceClasses.SSR_SUPPORT: The named test server-renders a production component but does not exercise a browser.
evidenceClasses.STATIC_SUPPORT: The named test inspects source structure or inventory and cannot prove runtime behavior.
evidenceClasses.DISCOVERED_NOT_RUN: The named browser test exists, but was not executed in this acceptance run.
evidenceClasses.IN_MEMORY_ONLY: The named test uses an in-memory store and does not prove process-restart persistence.

executionRecords.scope: An isolated credential-free Wrangler durable runtime created one synthetic workflow, stopped, restarted against the same temporary persistence path, and authenticated a read whose run ID, revision, state fingerprint, and original input matched.
executionRecords.limitations: This execution did not checkpoint a receipt, partial search, proposal, hold, scheduler callback, lease expiry, cleanup, two-tab race, or in-flight task across restart.
